versions.changelog:
Sovereign SEO Audit v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launch of a comprehensive SEO auditor skill covering Technical SEO, On-Page Optimization, Content Quality, Site Architecture, Mobile Optimization, Schema Markup, and Backlink Profile.
- Outputs a scored, actionable report with letter grade, prioritized fixes, and estimated effort/impact per finding.
- Performs detailed, rule-based checks for essential meta tags, Open Graph/social meta, sitemaps, robots.txt, and more.
- Auditing methodology and checklists based entirely on real-world SEO experience and site success.
- Designed to provide specific, auditable, non-generic recommendations for any website or codebase submitted.
